question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Obstinate
solution:
The correct answer is: **Stubborn**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Obstinate"** means stubbornly refusing to change one's opinion or chosen course of action, despite attempts to persuade one to do so. (हठी)
 
 
• **Example: **Despite many arguments, he remained obstinate in his decision to not sell the house.
 
 
 
• **"Stubborn" **refers to having or showing dogged determination not to change one's attitude or position on something, especially in spite of good arguments or reasons to do so. (जिद्दी)
 
 
• **Example: **The stubborn child refused to eat his vegetables.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Stubborn**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Obedient **(आज्ञाकारी): Complying or willing to comply with orders or requests; submissive to another's will.
 
 
• **Example:** The obedient dog sat quietly by his owner's side.
 
 
 
• **Adaptive **(अनुकूलनीय): Able to adjust to new conditions.
 
 
• **Example: **She is highly adaptive and can handle any situation.
 
 
 
• **Submissive **(आज्ञाकारी): Ready to conform to the authority or will of others; meekly obedient or passive.
 
 
• **Example:** The submissive employee never questioned his boss's decisions.
